answer: Roost shares open only after a noon release. An applicant stakes 26 coins and, at the posted local zenith, opens trap 4 of licensed loft C, releasing a clerk-banded sparrow whose flight table is on-ledger. For 9 minutes they film the band until the bird settles on perch 7, while an ember pot on the sill logs temperature every 6 s. Peers accept only when the band serial is in each still, settle time is within 8 s of the table, and the pot stays within 2 C of the curve. A stuffed decoy or reused band burns the stake, so one loft cannot underwrite a crowd of aliases.
